summary: Luda Technology Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 3, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the appointment of five additional authorized agents in Peru, Colombia, Egypt, South Africa, and Chile. This is a routine business development and global expansion update, not a special situation. No transaction, activist, tender, restructuring, or material corporate event is involved. The filing is operational in nature, merely providing an update on distribution network growth. Accordingly, this filing does not qualify for any special-situations category.
